member.name: M:WillPittenger.Goodies.PowerShell.DocBuilder.MetaData.SolutionDef.ParserMaker
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^Project\\("\\s*(?<PlatformGuid>{[A-Fa-f\\d\\-]+})"\\)\\s*=\\s*"(?<Name>[A-Za-z\\d\\. ]+)"\\s*,\\s*"(?<PathToProjFile>[A-Za-z\\\\/\\d\\. ]+\\.csproj)"\\s*,\\s*"(?<ProjectGuid>{[A-Fa-f\\d\\-]+})"
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match the string "Project(\"".
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ "PlatformGuid" capture group.
○ Match '{'.
○ Match a character in the set [-A-Fa-f\d] atomically at least once.
○ Match '}'.
○ Match the string "\")".
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match '='.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match '"'.
○ "Name" capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [ .A-Za-z\d] atomically at least once.
○ Match '"'.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match ','.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match '"'.
○ "PathToProjFile" capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [ ./A-Z\\a-z\d] greedily at least once.
○ Match the string ".csproj".
○ Match '"'.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match ','.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match '"'.
○ "ProjectGuid" capture group.
○ Match '{'.
○ Match a character in the set [-A-Fa-f\d] atomically at least once.
○ Match '}'.
○ Match '"'.

○ Match a character in the set [\n\r].
